items.headline: High Surf Warning issued November 14 at 12:53AM PST until November 14 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Warning, large waves and dangerous surf
conditions. Breakers up to 30 to 35 feet. For the High Surf
Advisory, large waves and hazardous surf conditions. Breakers up
to 23 to 28 feet.

* WHERE...North and Central Coast of Oregon, and South
Washington Coast.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Warning, until noon PST today. For
the High Surf Advisory, from noon today to 4 AM PST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Destructive waves may wash over beaches, jetties,
and other structures unexpectedly. People can be swept off
rocks and jetties and drown while observing high surf. Severe
beach erosion may destroy coastal properties and buildings.
Higher than normal water run-up is expected on beaches and low-
lying shoreline.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The threat of sneaker waves is extreme
during these scenarios. Sneaker waves can suddenly knock people
off of their feet and quickly pull them into the frigid ocean
which may lead to serious injury or drowning. The sneaker wave
threat will peak Friday evening into Friday night.
items.instruction:
A High Surf Warning means that high surf will affect beaches,
producing rip currents, sneaker waves and beach erosion. Stay
well back from the water's edge and be alert for exceptionally
high waves.

Keep away from large logs on the beach. Water running up on the
beach can lift or roll logs which can injure or kill someone
caught in their path.

items.headline: Storm Warning issued November 14 at 1:01AM PST until November 15 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and
hazardous seas 23 to 28 ft at 20 seconds and south winds 25 to
35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt. For the Storm Warning, seas 17
to 22 ft at 16 seconds and south winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts
up to 50 kt expected.

* WHERE...Inner Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence
out 10 NM.

* WHEN...Hazardous Seas Warning, until 4 PM PST this afternoon.
Storm Warning, from 4 PM this afternoon to 4 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Very strong winds will cause hazardous seas which
could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
A Storm Warning means winds of 48 to 63 knots are imminent or
occurring. Recreational boaters should remain in port, or take
shelter until winds and waves subside. Commercial vessels should
prepare for very strong winds and dangerous sea conditions, and
consider remaining in port or taking shelter in port until winds
and waves subside.
